sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
Wait — the eyes are at (22,18)/(22,45)?? In the image, the eyes are at rows 22-25, columns 18-21 and 42-45 — inside the window region! But the window is M... yet the eyes are there. So the eyes can exist within the window region?! The window's M is at rows 18-25, columns 14-49. Eyes at (22,18): rows 22-25, columns 18-21. In the image, the eyes are on top of the purple window. So the window is not a wall — the eyes can pass through it!
Wait, but earlier: at (14,26)/(14,34) I pressed DOWN → the eyes moved to (18,26) — that's inside the window (rows 18-21, columns 26-29)... and then UP×4 from (18,26) → (14,26). So the eyes were able to pass through the window without dying! I had been mistakenly treating the window as a wall!
So the window's M is passable (maybe it's a "glass" the eyes can see through, or just a decorative region). The real walls are only the M/P borders. Hazards: crack, stripe, band.
This changes everything! The eyes can be at any position within rows 6-37, columns 6-57 (excluding the crack/stripe/band).
And now the eyes are at (22,18)/(22,45) — inside the window. In the image, the eyes are on top of the purple.
So the goal might be inside the window! The window is the "target region" — maybe the eyes need to reach specific positions within the window and press SPACE.
The window is at rows 18-25, columns 14-49. The eyes are currently at (22,18)/(22,45).
Positions within the window (left eye's row, column), where both eyes fit within the window (columns 14-49): left eye's column c, right eye's column 63-(c+3). Both within [14,49]: c ≥ 14, 63-c-3 ≤ 49 → c ≥ 11. So c ∈ {14,18,22,26}, row ∈ {18,22}.

sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def eyes():
    lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    sr=[r for r in range(64) if 'S' in lines[r]]
    r=sr[0]; cs=[c for c in range(64) if lines[r][c]=='S']
    return sr[0], min(cs), max(cs)
def test(name):
    action(['SPACE'])
    print(name, 'level',current_frame.level,'done?',last_action_result.get('done'),'lc?',last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
    if current_frame.level!=2 or last_action_result.get('done'): raise SystemExit
print('pos',eyes()); test('win (22,18)')
action(['RIGHT']); print('pos',eyes()); test('win (22,22)')
action(['RIGHT']); print('pos',eyes()); test('win (22,26)')
action(['UP']); print('pos',eyes()); test('win (18,26)')
action(['LEFT']); print('pos',eyes()); test('win (18,22)')
action(['LEFT']); print('pos',eyes()); test('win (18,18)')
action(['LEFT']); print('pos',eyes()); test('win (18,14)')
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
